name: csv_query
description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT over one or more CSVs loaded as named tables into an in-memory SQLite database, with column types (INTEGER, REAL, TEXT) inferred and empty cells as NULL: GROUP BY, JOIN, window functions, CTEs. Returns JSON rows and the result as CSV. Read-only by construction: PRAGMA query_only, an authorizer that refuses ATTACH, PRAGMA, writes and load_extension, a single statement, a time budget and a row limit.

sql.description: One SELECT, WITH ... SELECT or VALUES statement

csv.description: A single CSV, loaded as table data (or the name in table)

delimiter.description: Override the sniffed delimiter; \t for tab

input.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

catalog.source: Python sqlite3 (SQLite) in memory, after csvkit's csvsql --query, datasette and q; read-only through sqlite3 set_authorizer and PRAGMA query_only
